digest.en: Iran's attacks on the UAE and commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz have prompted a US-mediated ceasefire. The US and Iran both claim control over the Strait of Hormuz. US officials, including Hegseth, affirm the ceasefire remains in effect despite rising tensions.
digest.hi: अमेरिका ने होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य में नौसेना की उपस्थिति बढ़ाने के प्रयासों के बीच ईरान के साथ संघर्ष विराम खतरे में पड़ गया है। आईएमएफ प्रमुख ने चेतावनी दी है कि अगर मध्य-पूर्व में युद्ध लंबा खिंचा तो और बुरे हालात होंगे। ईरान के साथ जारी तनाव को अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ट्रंप ने 'लघु युद्ध' बताया है।

articles.title: Iran ceasefire holding for now, Hegseth says, after Iran attacks UAE, ships in Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Iran's ceasefire appears to be holding after recent attacks on the UAE and ships in the Strait of Hormuz. US envoy Brian Hegseth confirmed the ceasefire, following heightened tensions between Iran and the US. The situation remains fragile.

articles.summary: The UAE's air defenses are actively engaging with Iranian missiles and drones. The US has threatened a "devastating" response to any Iranian attack on shipping, as President Trump urged Iran to "do the smart thing" and avoid escalation.

articles.title: Proposed UN resolution threatens Iran with sanctions if it doesn’t allow freedom of navigation
articles.summary: A proposed UN resolution threatens Iran with sanctions if it doesn't allow freedom of navigation. The resolution aims to pressure Iran into ensuring safe passage for ships in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway for global oil supplies.

articles.title: U.S. and Iran Both Claim Control Over Strait of Hormuz

articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine announced rival ceasefires, with Ukraine pausing fighting sooner to pin violations on Moscow. Russia demanded a ceasefire on 8 and 9 May but Ukraine said it would pause the fighting sooner, meaning any violations would be pinned on Moscow.

articles.title: West Bengal election win boosts Modi's BJP
